Organic grain residue and moisture risk corrosion of pipe threaded ends and protective coatings (epoxy, FBE); hospital clean standard for pipes cannot be reliably certified after grain cargo — manual surveyor review required

Grain is chemically inert relative to iron ore; standard wash and dry removes organic residue before iron ore loading. extra_clean required: next cargo is high-dust (iron ore, Group A fines) and hold must be fully dry to avoid TML complications

Organic moisture residue from grain reacts with DRI (metallic iron >90% Fe, Group B self-heating) generating H2 gas and triggering self-heating cascade; DRI requires inert-atmosphere (N2) hold — grain residue moisture is an absolute contraindication

Grain moisture residue increases humidity in hold, accelerating coal self-heating (Group B, spontaneous combustion risk) and methane/CO emission; organic grain matter incompatible with coal ventilation safety protocol

Residual grain moisture can raise hold humidity above 55°C threshold for green petcoke self-heating (Group B); organic grain residue incompatible with petcoke oily-dust surface chemistry — manual surveyor review required

Organic grain residue (carbohydrate/protein) contaminates fertilizer (nitrogen/phosphorus compounds), creating chemical cross-contamination; ammonium nitrate-based fertilizers (Group B MHB OH) require hospital clean with no organic matter — prior grain cargo almost certain rejection

Moisture from grain residue reacts with cement (calcium silicate) initiating premature hydration and calcium hydroxide deposition on hold surfaces; sugar traces in grain (even trace sucrose from damaged grain) can set-inhibit cement at 0.001% level

Grain organic residue and moisture promote H2SO4 formation when wet sulphur contacts hold surfaces; sulphur Group B (UN 1350, Class 4.1 flammable solid) — organic grain dust in contact with sulphur dust creates explosion hazard

Organic grain residue promotes mould and fermentation in hold, incompatible with scrap metal surveyor inspection standards; oil/battery-acid contamination from scrap works in reverse — grain residue organics contaminate scrap classification. Manual surveyor review required

Grain moisture residue introduces hold humidity that can elevate bauxite fines moisture content above TML (Group A liquefaction risk); red/brown bauxite dust requires extra_clean after high-moisture grain — manual surveyor review required before loading bauxite fines
